decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy is close to the firm's established care expertise and its own R&D supports learning, so the firm is unlikely to drop it.
Senior-living counseling builds on existing eldercare and counseling knowledge, and in-house R&D enables assimilation and improvement.
The sheltered-workshop retail shop leverages established practical and production know-how, and the firm's R&D supports further development.
Meal delivery for seniors is close to elder-care services, and the firm can interpret early results through R&D, though it is newer and less prominent on the website.
